Blocks.Text: RT2 1.4.11 · Updated for beta 0.114.0

Items: Added probability estimates for card transforms across multiple sources.

Blocks.Text: RT2 1.4.10 · Transform search

Items: Added GPU support for the remaining transform events and their transform combinations.

Blocks.Text: RT2 1.4.9 · Multiplayer seed search and route prediction

Items: Read the current lobby to fill in the player count, characters, unlocks and shared Ascension. Outside a lobby, build a party of 2–4 and choose each character. P1 defaults to your local unlocks and the other seats default to all unlocks.

In Act 2's Hive, you can switch to the Treasure Map layout. Reopening the game restores your planned route, and returning to a run shows the path already taken. RT2 remembers one solo run and the three most recent multiplayer runs.

At the bottom of the seed analysis overview, each Act has a row of predicted unknown rooms. Adjust how many you expect to visit. If the previous room was a shop, or every exit from this node leads to a fixed shop, click the unknown room to rule out a shop there. Later predictions in the same Act update. Click again to undo.

Personal relic queues skip only the relics you specify inside Capsules. When Neow’s Bones grants both Capsules, you can enter their contents separately or together. Equivalent pickup orders now share one result.
Elite and normal encounter portraits are larger. Select Show All to expand a sequence that exceeds one row.
On the beta branch, supported solo searches now use the GPU to count copies of a target card across opening transforms, Morphic Grove, and either Pandora’s Box or Astrolabe.

Blocks.Text: RT2 1.4.8 · Seed search compatibility and main menu launcher improvements

Items: Improved seed search compatibility with some mod setups.
Drag the main menu launcher to move it. Its position and visibility are saved between sessions. Press Ctrl+F7 to show or hide it by default. You can change the shortcut in RT2 settings.

Blocks.Text: RT2 1.4.7 Release Notes

Items: Fixed cases where RT2 incorrectly blocked predictions for some Ancient options.

Reduced startup time for some combinations of seed filters. In solo searches on the beta branch, Astrolabe and Pandora’s Box filters can now use GPU acceleration when the card pool and the number of cards to transform are known.

Blocks.Text: RT2 1.4.6 Release Notes
One RT2 installation now supports stable [b]0.111.1[/b] and beta [b]0.113.1[/b]. RT2 detects your game version at startup.
[b]New seed filters for 0.113[/b]

Items: [b]Ordinary shop relics[/b]  In solo search, choose the ordinary relics you want to buy in the first 1 to 3 shops. They can appear across different shops, in either ordinary relic slot.
[b]Event relic rewards[/b]  Filter seeds by the rarity of the relic an event option awards.

[b]Astrolabe and Pandora’s Box[/b]  Choose the cards you want to get from transforming starter cards and how many copies of each. Astrolabe assumes you transform three of your character’s starter cards. Pandora’s Box uses the Strikes and Defends left in your deck.

[b]Crystal Sphere[/b]  Set the relics you hold on entering the event and how many tiles you will reveal. Then choose a relic rarity and the cards you want. All selected rewards must be obtainable on a single reveal path.

Blocks.Text: [b]In-run predictions[/b]
Hover over War Hammer or Fishing Rod to see which cards will be upgraded next. Hover over Pael’s Tooth to see the order in which your cards will return.
Searches with certain combinations of filters are also faster.
